# orq_environment (Resource)

A deployment environment. It is owned either by one project (`project_id`) or by the workspace (`sharing`); exactly one of the two must be set and the choice cannot change without replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orq_project" "example" {
  name = "Production"
}

# A project-owned environment.
resource "orq_environment" "staging" {
  slug         = "staging"
  display_name = "Staging"
  description  = "Pre-production checks"
  project_id   = orq_project.example.id
}

# A workspace-owned environment sets `sharing` instead of `project_id`:
#
# resource "orq_environment" "production" {
#   slug         = "production"
#   display_name = "Production"
#   sharing = {
#     all_projects = true
#   }
# }
#
# Or shared with specific projects only:
#
# resource "orq_environment" "canary" {
#   slug         = "canary"
#   display_name = "Canary"
#   sharing = {
#     project_ids = [orq_project.example.id]
#   }
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable environment name (1-255 characters).
- `slug` (String) Environment slug (1-64 characters: lowercase letters and digits, separated by single `-` or `_`). Unique among the environments a project can see. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description (at most 1024 characters). Removing the attribute keeps the stored value; set it to `""` to clear it.
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the environment. Mutually exclusive with `sharing`. Changing this forces replacement.
- `sharing` (Attributes) Project access for a workspace-owned environment. Mutually exclusive with `project_id`. Exactly one of `all_projects` or `project_ids` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sharing))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Environment ID assigned by orq.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sharing`

Optional:

- `all_projects` (Boolean) Share with every project in the workspace. Only accepts `true` — to share with no project set `project_ids = []` instead. Mutually exclusive with `project_ids`.
- `allow_fork` (Boolean) Allow consuming projects to fork the environment into a project-owned copy. Omitted stores `false`.
- `allow_version_pin` (Boolean) Allow consuming projects to pin a specific version. Omitted stores `false`.
- `auto_grant_new_projects` (Boolean) Automatically grant new projects access. Omitted stores `false`. Only valid with `all_projects` (combining it with an explicit `project_ids` list is rejected).
- `project_ids` (List of String) Share with exactly these projects (at most 100). An empty list means shared with no project. Ids must be unique and non-null. Mutually exclusive with `all_projects`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Environments are imported by their prefixed id.
terraform import orq_environment.staging env_01kypdh9ga3f9m6gptyz6v9h7n
```
